help:
usage: vpnctl.py [-h] [--state STATE] [--config CONFIG]
                 [--compose-file COMPOSE_FILE]
                 {init,import-config,render,upstream,route,policy,node,health,profile,client,quota,usage,link,endpoint,subscription,inventory,up,down,restart,status,logs,validate} ...

Manage a Docker Compose Xray VLESS + REALITY VPN server.

positional arguments:
  {init,import-config,render,upstream,route,policy,node,health,profile,client,quota,usage,link,endpoint,subscription,inventory,up,down,restart,status,logs,validate}
    init                Create state and render the initial Xray config.
    import-config       Import an existing Xray JSON config into vpnctl state.
    render              Render config from state.
    upstream            Show or change the upstream VPN.
    route               Assign profile routing policies.
    policy              Manage named routing policies.
    node                Configure local node role and routing guard.
    health              Inspect or probe upstream paths on this gateway.
    profile             Manage VPN profiles.
    client              Manage clients.
    quota               Manage monthly traffic quotas.
    usage               Show persisted usage.
    link                Print a VLESS link for a client.
    endpoint            Manage independent remote client entries.
    subscription        Export a private combined subscription file.
    inventory           Manage separate infrastructure metadata.
    up                  Start Xray.
    down                Stop Xray.
    restart             Restart Xray.
    status              Show Compose service status.
    logs                Follow Xray logs.
    validate            Validate the rendered Xray config inside the
                        container.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state STATE         Path to vpnctl state JSON.
  --config CONFIG       Path to rendered Xray config JSON.
  --compose-file COMPOSE_FILE
                        Path to Docker Compose file.

init.help:
usage: vpnctl.py init [-h] --server-host SERVER_HOST
                      [--upstream-link UPSTREAM_LINK]
                      --reality-target REALITY_TARGET
                      [--default-domain DEFAULT_DOMAIN]
                      [--mode {direct,proxy,both}] [--port PORT]
                      [--direct-port DIRECT_PORT] [--proxy-port PROXY_PORT]
                      [--profile PROFILE] --client CLIENT [--quota QUOTA]
                      [--force]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --server-host SERVER_HOST
                        Public IP or DNS name clients connect to.
  --upstream-link UPSTREAM_LINK
                        VLESS + REALITY client link for an upstream VPN.
  --reality-target REALITY_TARGET
                        REALITY target, for example www.cloudflare.com:443.
  --default-domain DEFAULT_DOMAIN
                        Domain used in generated client emails. Defaults to
                        server host.
  --mode {direct,proxy,both}
                        Initial outbound profile mode.
  --port PORT           Public VLESS port for direct-only or proxy-only init.
                        Defaults to 443.
  --direct-port DIRECT_PORT
                        Public VLESS port for the direct profile in both mode.
  --proxy-port PROXY_PORT
                        Public VLESS port for the proxy profile in both mode.
  --profile PROFILE     Initial profile name for direct-only or proxy-only
                        init.
  --client CLIENT       Initial client name. Repeatable.
  --quota QUOTA         Optional initial monthly quota for all created
                        clients, for example 50GiB.
  --force               Overwrite existing state.
